environment.description: Same worker deployed in VPC vpc-0def456 with S3 Gateway Endpoint vpce-0x9f8e7d configured with a custom endpoint policy. The endpoint policy document specifies a Condition block with StringEquals on 's3:prefix' restricting PutObject to keys matching 'results/${aws:PrincipalTag/workflowId}/*' and a secondary Condition using 'aws:ResourceTag/classification' != 'sensitive' on the results bucket. Additionally, the VPC has no NAT gateway and no internet gateway — all S3 traffic MUST traverse the VPC endpoint. The endpoint policy also includes a blanket Deny for any PutObject where the Content-Length header exceeds 4096 bytes, enforced via NumericGreaterThan on s3:content-length-range. The worker's IAM role has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::111222333444:policy/WorkflowBoundary) that denies s3:PutObject when StringLike on s3:prefix matches '*output.json' AND the request context includes objects larger than 4KB.
